in_hebrew.name: מרגאואל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'mar' (light) and 'ga' (god) or 'gad' (troop, host), this name means 'God is my light' or 'God is my troop'.

in_greek.name: Μαργεαύς
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Margeaux' is derived from the Greek name 'Margos' (μαργός), which means 'shining' or 'illustrious', and the Greek suffix 'auo' (αύο), meaning 'god'. Thus, 'Margeaux' in Greek could be interpreted as 'Shining God' or 'Illustrious God'.

in_latin.name: Margauel
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Margeaux' is derived from the Latin name 'Margus' (Margus), which means 'shining' or 'illustrious', and the Latin word 'deus' (deus), meaning 'god'. Thus, 'Margeaux' in Latin could be interpreted as 'Shining God' or 'Illustrious God'.
